newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks end higher, blue-chips upbeat.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks end higher, blue-chips upbeat.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed higher on Wednesday, as shares of major multinational companies continued to attract investors, supported by the yen's retreat against the dollar. But the market's upside was capped by strong selling demand, brokers said.
The key Nikkei 225 average rose 228.79 points, or 1.26 percent, to end at 18,409.96. It had briefly climbed as high as 18,520.76. Its March futures were 190 points higher at 18,390.
"The yen eased sufficiently and this will benefit (blue-chip) firms' earnings," said Kazuo Shiogai, deputy branch manager at ING Baring Securities (Japan) Ltd.
